cues.text: Open the Huawei VRP configuration in the visual notes for exact command syntax.
Enter system view and create VLANs ten and twenty.
Configure Gigabit Ethernet zero slash zero slash one as an access port in VLAN ten, and port zero slash zero slash two as an access port in VLAN twenty.
Port zero slash zero slash twenty-four is a trunk permitting both VLANs.
Then create VLAN interfaces ten and twenty.
Assign one ninety-two dot one sixty-eight dot ten dot one and one ninety-two dot one sixty-eight dot twenty dot one respectively, both with a slash twenty-four mask.
Those addresses become the gateways for their respective hosts.
The display commands inspect VLAN membership, learned MAC addresses, and the IP routing table.
This requires a layer three-capable VRP switch with suitable interface types.
Don't mistake a trunk for a routed port.
Test allowed and denied flows with an explicit access control list.
The precise commands remain in the source, so you can follow along rather than memorising punctuation from speech.
